mapper.insert: insert into "h_churn_result" (model_id, churn_rate, top1_reason, top2_reason, top3_reason) values (#{modelId}, #{churnRate}, #{top1Reason}, #{top2Reason}, #{top3Reason})
mapper.select:
select r.result_id, r.model_id, r.churn_rate, r.top1_reason, r.top2_reason, r.top3_reason from "h_churn_result" r
join "h_model_data" m ON r.model_id = m.model_id join "h_member" mem ON m.username = mem.username where mem.gym_id = #{gymId}

choose.when: select to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') as period, cast(round(avg(total_members)) as int) as totalMembers, avg(avg_churn_rate) as avgChurnRate from "h_churn_gym_daily" where gym_id = #{gymId} group by to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') order by period desc
choose.otherwise: select to_char(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as period, total_members as totalMembers, avg_churn_rate as avgChurnRate from "h_churn_gym_daily" where gym_id = #{gymId} order by stat_date desc

choose.when: select s.stat_type as statType, s.stat_key as statKey, cast(sum(s.member_count) as int) as memberCount, round(avg(s.member_count * 100.0 / g.total_members), 1) as pct from "h_churn_stat_daily" s join "h_churn_gym_daily" g on s.gym_id = g.gym_id and s.stat_date = g.stat_date where g.gym_id = #{gymId} and to_char(g.stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{period} group by s.stat_type, s.stat_key order by s.stat_type, pct desc
choose.otherwise: select s.stat_type as statType, s.stat_key as statKey, s.member_count as memberCount, round(s.member_count * 100.0 / g.total_members, 1) as pct from "h_churn_stat_daily" s join "h_churn_gym_daily" g on s.gym_id = g.gym_id and s.stat_date = g.stat_date where g.gym_id = #{gymId} and g.stat_date = cast(#{period} as date) order by s.stat_type, pct desc
